simple.meaning: קׇרְחָה (qorchâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “baldness.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 11 times in Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, and 2 more, beginning at Leviticus 21:5. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קׇרְחָה (H7144) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קׇרְחָה (qorchâh) / H7144 is traced through Leviticus 21:5, Deuteronomy 14:1, Isaiah 3:24, Isaiah 15:2 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: “ ‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

timeline.evidenceText: “ ‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
You are the children of Yahweh your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness;
They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.
In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
They will make themselves bald for you,
I will turn your feasts into mourning,

definitions.full: H7144. qorchah or qorcha קָרְחָה noun feminine baldness, bald spot , made as sign of mourning; — absolute ׳ק Isa 3:24 +; suffix קָרְחָתֵח Micah 1:16 ; — bald spot , עַלכָּֿלרֿאֹשׁ Amos 8:10 , ׳בְּכָלרֿ Isa 15:2 ; Ezek 7:18 ; ׳ק בְּראֹשׁ Lev 21:5 (accusative of congnate meaning with verb); ק ׳כָּלרֿאֹשׁ Jer 48:37 ; ׳ק כַנֶּשֶׁר Micah 1:16 ; עֵינֵיכֶם בֵּין Deut 14:1 ; opposed to מִקְשֶׁה מַעֲשֶׂה Isa 3:24 ; also Jer 47:5 and (accusative of congnate meaning with verb) Ezek 27:31 .
